**Build passes clean, 0 errors.**

Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | read `options.retries`, new shape sends `retryCount` | read `options.retryCount` |
| [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | threw on `undefined` flag instead of treating it as off | unset now resolves to `false` |

The rest was deprecation noise from the bumped bundler, unrelated to these two.

Next: nothing. Build's green.
